name: Phaedrus Estate
signature: A family wine estate and cellar door in Moorooduc with Fiano, Pinot Gris, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Shiraz.
editorNote: Phaedrus Estate's official site places its cellar door at 220 Mornington-Tyabb Road, Moorooduc. The family estate produces a range including Fiano, Pinot Gris, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Shiraz. Check the operator for current visit details before travelling.
whyWeGo: A Moorooduc family estate with a broad range of wines beyond the usual Pinot and Chardonnay.
ifOnlyOneThing: Confirm current cellar-door hours and directions on the operator's site before travelling.

heroImage.alt: A long-exposure photograph beneath a concrete pier, a black pipe running down the sand into smooth water under a clouded sky.
heroImage.depicts: a long exposure beneath a concrete pier, a pipe running down the sand into the water

The street number matches and nothing else does.
